'''Christel Maria Marian''' (4 June 1954) is a German chemist.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.awk.nrw.de/akademie/klassen/naturmedizin/ordentliche-mitglieder/marian-christel.html|title=AWK: Marian, Christel|website=www.awk.nrw.de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://www.theochem.hhu.de/fileadmin/redaktion/Fakultaeten/Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftliche_Fakultaet/Chemie/Theo_Chem/Marian/CV_Marian_June_2017.pdf|title=CV Marian|website=www.theochem.hhu.de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref> She is a full professor and the director of the institute of theoretical and computational chemistry at the [[University of Düsseldorf]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wz.de/nrw/duesseldorf/christel-marian-im-interview-viele-frauen-trauen-sich-eine-akademische-karriere-nicht-zu_aid-29673425|title=Christel Marian im Interview: "Viele Frauen trauen sich eine akademische Karriere nicht zu"|last=Zeitung|first=Westdeutsche|website=Westdeutsche Zeitung|date=16 February 2014 |language=de|access-date=2019-01-19}}</ref>

== Education and professional life ==
Marian studied chemistry in Cologne and Bonn.<ref name=":0" /> She finished her doctorate in Theoretical Chemistry at the [[University of Bonn]] under the supervision of [[Sigrid D. Peyerimhoff]] in 1980.<ref name=":0" /> She did a postdoc in the Theoretical Physics Department of [[Stockholm University]] (Sweden) in the group of [[Per Siegbahn|Per E. M. Siegbahn]].<ref name=":1" /> She completed her habilitation at the [[University of Bonn]] in 1991.<ref name=":0" /> In 2001, she joined the [[University of Düsseldorf]] as a full professor.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-duesseldorf.de/home/universitaet/weiterfuehrend/pressebereich/pressemeldungen/news-detailansicht/article/zwei-neue-lehrstuhlinhaber-ernannt-1.html?cHash=f8c29641ca2e91c0294d8ea8b1d7753b|title=Zwei neue Lehrstuhlinhaber ernannt|website=www.uni-duesseldorf.de|language=de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref> Between 2011 and 2015, she was Dean of the Mathematical and Natural Science Faculty at the [[University of Düsseldorf]].<ref name=":1" />

== Personal life ==
She has two daughters.<ref name=":3" />

== Research ==
Her research focuses on the development and application of theoretical and computational excited-state electronic structure methods – also for biomolecules.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://www.theochem.hhu.de/en/our-team/curriculum-vitae-prof-dr-christel-marian.html|title=Universität Düsseldorf: Curriculum vitae Prof. Dr. Christel Marian|website=www.theochem.hhu.de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite book|title=Zweihundert Jahre Entwicklung der Theoretischen Chemie im deutschsprachigen Raum|last=Jug|first=Karl|publisher=Springer-Verlag|year=2014|isbn=978-3-662-43365-2|location=Berlin [Germany]|pages=166|oclc=894508769}}</ref> She also worked on spin-orbit coupling in molecules.<ref name=":2" />

* {{Cite journal|last=Marian|first=Christel M.|date=2012|title=Spin–orbit coupling and intersystem crossing in molecules|journal=Wiley Interdisciplinary Reviews: Computational Molecular Science|language=en|volume=2|issue=2|pages=187–203|doi=10.1002/wcms.83|s2cid=97659596|issn=1759-0884}}

* {{Cite journal|last=Marian|first=Christel M.|date=2007-03-01|title=The Guanine Tautomer Puzzle: Quantum Chemical Investigation of Ground and Excited States|journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry A|volume=111|issue=8|pages=1545–1553|doi=10.1021/jp068620v|pmid=17274608|bibcode=2007JPCA..111.1545M|issn=1089-5639}}
